utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday, seventh of May. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: We can hear you. More importantly, there's a birthday cake in the office. Proper cake, not one of those protein things.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's the most useful production update we've had all week.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'm hoping the weather holds for the weekend. Had grand plans for a walk, but the forecast's gone back to sideways rain.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Standard bank holiday recovery weather. Back at work, sun comes out; weekend, absolutely buckets down.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we become the weather channel—what's already finished?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, so, finished the repair on the line 2 last night. That's complete, not something I'm carrying into today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, we had that back. Much quieter on the radio afterwards.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the boiler last night as well. Both closed off.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Lovely. I saw the boiler entry, just hadn't heard the bit about line 2.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: While we're on completed stuff, I already swapped the filter on the number two bearing yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's the bearing one, yeah? Not the compressed-air filter.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. Separate thing. Yesterday's job, done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, the compressed-air filter is still outstanding, then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, Air Compressor 1. That's the one we're talking about, not the bearing filter.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll swap the filter on the Air Compressor 1 by Thursday. It's urgent, so I'm taking that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace Liu. Air Compressor 1 is yours, then.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep. By Thursday means today, so we're clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie Brennan, can you do a site visit at the substation with the contractor by end of day? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that one. I'm not available to go out with the contractor today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, PR, can you take that instead—do a site visit at the substation with the contractor by end of day, normal priority?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it. Site visit at the substation with the contractor, by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, I spoke over the end there. Was that still with Jamie?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, with me. Normal priority, but still by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: One observation while I've got the mic: heard a slight rattle from the GT1 Compressor Section. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, just an observation at this point. Not a new job off the back of that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Separately, I'll grease and check the bearings on the GT1 compressor this morning.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, Saz. That's the bearing job, separate from Jamie's rattle comment.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. I'm taking the grease and bearing check, not adding an investigation.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Production-wise, the guarding is the awkward one. That's where we're being held up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah Price, can you check the guarding on the Main Outfeed Conveyor by the 28th? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I'll check the guarding on the Main Outfeed Conveyor. By the 28th, and that goes first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Thanks. It's the order of work I was worried about, really, not just having a date against it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Understood. First, not squeezed in behind the routine stuff.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Hannah Price, can you update the risk assessment for work on the number two bearing by Thursday? That one's normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the number two bearing by Thursday. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just so we don't accidentally double it up, the filter swap I mentioned is already done.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. I'm taking the risk assessment update, not another filter swap.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, can you also run a function test on the line 1 TCU on the 3rd? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, I'll run a function test on the line 1 TCU on the 3rd. Got the urgency.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's a function test, rather than calibration? Sorry, Teams clipped the first couple of words.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Function test, yeah. Not a calibration job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: The calibration is separate. Jamie Brennan, can you recalibrate the sensors on the air dryer by Wednesday? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I can take that. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the air dryer by Wednesday, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, air dryer sensors with Jamie, function test on the line 1 TCU with Hannah. Two different things.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's it. Heard air dryer clearly, even through this lovely headset.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Oh, and I'll send the shift handover report round tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. Tomorrow for the shift handover report.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep. Saves everyone wondering where it is.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Any blocked or deferred stuff we need to keep separate from those commitments?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Can't get to the Stretch Wrapper until production gives us a window. Still blocked, so I'm not taking that on as a job for today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: There's no window available at the minute. Nothing's changed there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Stretch Wrapper stays blocked. No action coming out of this meeting on that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the boiler feed pump, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, so that hasn't quietly crept back onto today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No. Deferred to next month, not being handed out today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good. The cake, on the other hand, is definitely available today. No production window required.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Depends how wide the queue outside the office is.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Still a better prospect than my weekend picnic, by the sound of it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Just to keep the priorities straight: Main Outfeed Conveyor guarding first because it's holding production up. Air Compressor 1 is urgent, and the line 1 TCU function test is urgent too.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I've got that. Guarding first, and the dates on my other bits as agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. That's everyone. Thanks all, I'll let you get on.
